module_summary: SERV program counter unit: a 32-bit PC shift register updated bit-serially from a next-PC mux over PC+4, PC/imm offset adder and trap vector.

anchors.name: o_ibus_adr
anchors.why: PC shift register driving instruction bus address; shifted in new_pc.

anchors.name: new_pc
anchors.why: Next-PC mux: trap vector, jump target or PC+4.

anchors.name: pc_plus_4
anchors.why: Serial PC increment result for sequential next PC and link value.

anchors.name: pc_plus_offset
anchors.why: Serial offset adder result for branch/jump target and AUIPC.

anchors.name: pc_plus_4_cy_r
anchors.why: Carry flip-flop of the serial PC+4 adder.

anchors.name: pc_plus_offset_cy_r
anchors.why: Carry flip-flop of the serial PC+offset adder.

anchors.name: i_pc_en
anchors.why: Enables PC shift register update and carry registers.

anchors.name: i_jump
anchors.why: Selects jump target over PC+4 for new_pc.

anchors.name: i_trap
anchors.why: Selects CSR trap vector for new_pc.

anchors.name: i_utype
anchors.why: Selects immediate operand for offset adder and AUIPC result on o_rd.

anchors.name: i_imm
anchors.why: Serial immediate operand for U-type offset.

anchors.name: i_buf
anchors.why: Serial offset from buffer register for branches and jumps.

anchors.name: i_csr_pc
anchors.why: Serial trap vector from CSR unit.

anchors.name: o_rd
anchors.why: Serial rd result: PC+4 link or PC+offset for AUIPC/LUI.

anchors.name: o_bad_pc
anchors.why: Aligned jump target exported for misalignment trap value.

groups.name: PC register
groups.description: 32-bit PC shift register with reset and enable.

groups.name: Next PC logic
groups.description: Serial PC+4 and PC+offset adders feeding next-PC mux.

groups.name: Data ports
groups.description: Serial immediate, buffer, CSR vector inputs and rd, bad_pc outputs.
